title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BENCH:BACK REST (319,181 affected)

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (6,838 affected)

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (7,526 affected)

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER (3,500 affected)
summary: THE SERVICE BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER WAS NOT PROPERLY ASSEMBLED OR COULD HAVE BEEN DAMAGED BY THE EVACUATION AND FILLING OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM AT THE ASSEMBLY PLANT.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (3,500 affected)

title: MALLARD COACH CORP.: STRUCTURE (31 affected)

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (554,910 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT (ECU) FOR THE POWER DOOR LOCK SYSTEM CAN FAIL, CAUSING THE CONTACTS TO "WELD", AND RESULTING IN DOOR LOCK SOLENOID DAMAGE, WITH FAILURE OF THE DOOR TO LOCK OR UNLOCK, EVEN UNDER MANUAL OPERATION.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER/WASHER SWITCH (2,942 affected)

title: VALEO THERMIQUE HABITACLE: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HEATER CORE:WATER (30,000 affected)

title: Mazda North American Operations: WHEELS (15,822 affected)
